preconditions.expression: len(s) >= 1 and len(s) <= 5000000 and all(c.islower() for c in s)
preconditions.description: Input string s is non-empty, consists of lowercase English letters, and has length up to 5,000,000.
Integer k is at least 1 and at most the length of s.

postconditions.expression: all(len(t) >= 1 for t in t_list) and len(t_list) <= k and ''.join(t_list) == s
postconditions.description: The string s is partitioned into at most k non-empty substrings t_list.

postconditions.expression: all(t == t_list[i] or t == t_list[i][::-1] for i, t in enumerate(t_prime_list)) and ''.join(t_prime_list) == stdout
postconditions.description: Each substring in t_list is either kept as-is or reversed to form t_prime_list, which is concatenated to produce the lexicographically smallest possible string stdout.

postconditions.expression: not any(stdout < candidate for candidate in possible_outputs) and all(candidate >= stdout for candidate in possible_outputs)
postconditions.description: The output stdout is the lexicographically smallest string achievable by any valid partition and reversal operation.
